Starting Balances — Special Accounts

The Starting Balances - Special Accounts screen allows you to set up starting balances for the special accounts you've created under the Special Accounts tab. This is essential when you're migrating to Manager or when you need to input existing balances for these accounts.

To create a new starting balance for a special account, click the New Starting Balance button.

SpecialAccountsNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the selected special account. Here, you can enter the initial balance for that account.

For detailed instructions on how to complete the starting balance form, see Starting Balance for Special Account Form.
